name: Shindou Ringo
source:
The protagonist of this tale: Shindou Ringo, you, or someone else entirely.

A meek, shy, and gentle girl who had become a shut-in to avoid the constant friction taking place between people irl. She seems to have a certain aversion towards what society considers ‘common sense’, and can even come across as ‘twisted’ in certain situations. 

Although she usually describes herself as ‘socially inept’, she can be quite assertive. She’s also quite perceptive and tends to choose her words carefully. Her humour is top notch.
